Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: 7 November 2026

What you’re buying

Premium costs ₹500 and gives 30 days of Premium features from the moment your payment is confirmed. It is a one-time payment and does not renew automatically, so there is nothing to cancel.

Refunds

  • Charged but Premium didn’t start, or charged twice: we refund the extra or failed payment in full.
  • Changed your mind: email us within 7 days of paying, and if you haven’t hosted an event in that time, we’ll refund you in full.
  • After 7 days, or once you’ve hosted an event, payments aren’t refundable, but your Premium keeps working until it ends.
  • If we suspend your account for breaking our Terms, unused Premium time isn’t refunded.

How to ask

Email support@thestillroom.site from the address on your account, with the date of payment and the Razorpay payment ID (in your payment receipt). Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.
